inputs.text: [excited] It was 6 meters long — as long as a road is wide, it takes up the whole street! [quickly] Standing up, it was 2 meters tall — as tall as a front door! And it weighed 900 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as a small car! [serious] And it could run about 16 miles an hour — as fast as a bike going fast.
[amazed] Smaller than the big carnivore kings?
[confident] Yes, but fast and nimble. [proud] Its horn made it one of a kind.
